sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We deeply value our twelve-year partnership and welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract.
While we treat our detailed internal calculations as confidential, our team will provide further context regarding your request.
In recognition of the extended contract term and the April 2027 effective date, we can offer a revised price of €51.80 per unit with 30-day payment terms.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We appreciate your improved offer and your continued commitment to our twelve-year partnership.
In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.10 for the 30-day payment term.
This is a substantial concession on our part to reach a mutually beneficial agreement.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For twelve years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH with components of the highest quality. We deeply value our shared history in the region and the successful partnership we have built together over the years. 

In response, we are taking another step towards you and can now offer a price of €50.70 for this package. Our offer includes a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are confident that we can bridge the remaining gap and continue our successful twelve-year partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
